reasons: Rule is in scope: this is a services (consulting) MSA, and the cited termination provisions (p0032, p0033, p0044) address only notice, final fees and assignment of Works in progress — no transition assistance, no data/Confidential Information return window, and no deletion/certification, so neither the preferred nor the 90-day/30-day fallback is met; 'missing' is the correct status.

Redline is a clean insertion as a new Section 6(d) that leaves existing text untouched and tracks the model language, correctly mapped to this contract's parties and defined terms (Contractor/Company, Works, Confidential Information): six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter.
Comment is accurate, appropriately scoped and in the required voice/prefix; it explains what changed and offers the 90-day fallback while preserving the 30-day return and deletion certificate.

Deterministic checks pass and the minor broadening beyond the model language (including Works and Confidential Information in the return/deletion scope) is consistent with the rule's intent and favors our party, so it is not over-reach.
